preconditions.description: The input integer n is a positive integer within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if a valid sequence exists, or 'NO' if no valid sequence exists.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> (exists a permutation of [1, 2, ..., n] such that its prefix product sequence is a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n - 1])
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then there exists a permutation of [1, 2, ..., n] whose prefix product sequence is a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n - 1].

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' ==> (no permutation of [1, 2, ..., n] has a prefix product sequence that is a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n - 1])
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', then no permutation of [1, 2, ..., n] has a prefix product sequence that is a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n - 1].
